summary: The candidate is a partial structural refactor but changes AMD one-shot and chunked-KV core dispatch to the ordinary core. Its own test encodes that changed behavior, while an independent oracle derived from the exact pre-refactor routes fails two cases.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction: the recorded base has no deepseek_common.hardware_backend package, so collection raises ModuleNotFoundError.
Candidate-provided focused regressions: 30 passed and 8 subtests passed.
Independent preservation of the three pre-refactor AMD MHA core routes: ordinary passed; one-shot and chunked-KV failed.

gpu_execution.evidence: One AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 was detected, but the decisive dispatch regression is a pre-kernel mock test; no GPU numerical result is claimed.

remaining_counterexamples: MHA_ONE_SHOT_ROCM dispatches to forward_normal_core instead of the pre-refactor forward_normal_one_shot_core.
MHA_CHUNKED_KV_ROCM dispatches to forward_normal_core instead of the pre-refactor forward_normal_chunked_kv_core.
Many non-attention CPU, ROCm/CUDA, NPU, and MUSA conditionals remain in deepseek_v2.py, so the original broad refactor is incomplete.
Real DeepSeek V3.2 Indexer/IndexerKPool loading, logits, serving, semantic accuracy, and a distributed top-k stage handoff remain unverified.
remaining_limitations: No DeepSeek V3.2 checkpoint or model weights were available.
Only one AMD GPU was assigned; multi-GPU and pipeline-parallel execution were unavailable.
NPU, NVIDIA, CPU-only, and MUSA runtime paths were not executed.
No native source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
